label: v5_base_mse_s0_ep390_r3_stay_es0
config_content:
# P1 v5 base stage (research_plan_v4_v5.md Sec.4.2). The Q-input version of
# the paper's exp1_mse: Visual Encoder + SM + Integration + Decoder + FPM all
# trained FROM SCRATCH (pretrain: ~), so we can test whether the mechanism
# self-organises self/other visual representations when the SM side-channel
# is a probe-Q vector instead of m_t.
#
# Diff vs ROOT config/exp/exp1_mse.yml (5 lines):
#   model.name : SuperpositionNetworkFeaturePrediction -> SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ  (m_t -> 8-dim probe-Q)
#   data.name  : self_random_other_stay -> r3_stay  (Q-input dataset; A-2 static, same "other stay" semantics)
#   train.freeze: ~ -> [probe_critic]  (A-1's SAC critic is a given, must NOT be trained)
#   train.max_epochs : 200 -> 400  (R3-A/R3-stay both needed 400ep to phase-transition; scratch is likely slower)
#   train.save_interval : 1 -> 10  (exp1_mse used 1 for Fig.5 epoch selection; not needed, saves ~1GB disk)
# Everything else identical: mse_loss, batch 10, test_interval 10, AdamW, lr 1e-3,
# weight_decay 1e-2, per_params (bias wd=0, vision_encoder wd=1e-3, share_lns wd=1e-3).
model:
  name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ
  config: default
  mode: ~
runner: PredictionFeaturePredictionRunner
data:
  name: r3_stay
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99
train:
  loss_function: mse_loss
  pretrain: ~
  batch_size: 10
  max_epochs: 400
  save_interval: 10
  test_interval: 10
  optimizer: AdamW
  optim_config:
    default:
      lr: 0.001
      weight_decay: 0.01
    freeze:
      - probe_critic
    per_params:
      - name: bias
        args:
          weight_decay: 0.0
      - name: vision_encoder
        args:
          weight_decay: 0.001
      - name: share_lns
        args:
          weight_decay: 0.001
